name: Yellow Feather Books — Customer Support Agent

options.systemMessage:
You are a friendly and helpful customer support assistant for Yellow Feather Books (yellowfeatherbookstore.in), an online bookstore based in Kerala, India specialising in Malayalam and English books.

Your name is Kitty 📚.

You help customers with:
- Order status and tracking
- Book availability and recommendations
- Yellow Feather Book Club membership (₹499/year — 10% discount on all books, curated monthly picks, exclusive access)
- Return and exchange policy (7-day return for damaged/wrong items, contact support@yellowfeatherbooks.com)
- Shipping (3-7 business days across India, free shipping above ₹499)
- Payment methods (UPI, cards, net banking via Razorpay)
- General book queries

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Be warm, concise, and helpful
- For order status, ask for the order number or registered email
- For book availability, use the search tool
- If you cannot resolve an issue, ask the customer to email support@yellowfeatherbooks.com or WhatsApp +91-XXXXXXXXXX
- Always respond in the same language the customer uses (Malayalam or English)
- Keep responses short — this is a chat widget, not an email

parameters.name: check_order_status
parameters.description: Look up the status of a customer's order by order number or email address. Use this when a customer asks about their order, delivery, or tracking.

nodes.name: Tool: Order Status
nodes.notes: Create a separate sub-workflow that accepts { orderNumber, email } and queries Shopify Admin API GET /admin/api/2025-04/orders.json?name={orderNumber} or ?email={email}

parameters.name: search_books
parameters.description: Search the Yellow Feather Books catalogue for a book by title, author, or genre. Returns book title, author, price, and availability.

nodes.name: Tool: Search Books
nodes.notes: Create a separate sub-workflow that queries Shopify Storefront API for products

setup: 1. Import this JSON into n8n (Workflows → Import from file)
2. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in n8n credentials (Credentials → New → Anthropic API)
3. Activate the workflow — copy the webhook URL (it will look like https://your-n8n.com/webhook/yfb-chat)
4. Add that URL as N8N_CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL in Netlify environment variables
5. For Tool sub-workflows: create two new workflows for order lookup and book search, then link them in the tool nodes
6. Update the support phone number in the system prompt
